messages:
morgan: Heads-up — ran the MTEB-like rerank suite on quantized-v2 with the new runner prefetch enabled and saw a reproducible ~3.2% NDCG@10 drop vs baseline.

raj: ugh. any obvious diffs in candidate counts or top-k?

morgan: candidate counts stable, but spot-checked a few queries and noticed duplicate prefixes in the rerank candidates and some ordering skew. logs attached below.

morgan: ```
runner.config: { prefetch_enabled: true, kv_prefetch_window: 3, shard_affinity: "balanced-v2" }
query_id=Q3 hits: candidates=100, duplicates=2
candidate_ids: [a1, a1, b2, c3, d4, ...]
```

ani: that config change to shard_affinity="balanced-v2" was landed in the same CL as kv prefetch, right? could be interaction.

sam: hypothesis: prefetch window + affinity rebalance causes KV cache entries for a shard to be reused across adjacent logical queries when batching is enabled, leaking prefix state into subsequent requests.

morgan: that matches the sample — the duplicated a1 had an identical prefix token sequence.

raj: can you repro with --batch-size=1 and prefetch enabled? if it disappears then it's definitely a batching+prefetch interaction.

morgan: running quick local: `./eval_runner --suite rerank --model quantized-v2 --batch-size 1 --prefetch=on`

morgan: result: NDCG delta is gone at batch-size=1. with batch-size=8 delta appears again.

eval-bot: CI summary: rerank-eval (quantized-v2) failed at 2026-03-20T11:02:13Z. NDCG@10 drop = 3.2%. Repro script: ./ci/repro/1965432100.sh

lee: quick fix idea: namespace KV prefetch by request_id/shard_id and flush partial entries between batches. cheap guard: `kv.prefetch.isolate_per_request = true`

sam: alternative: limit kv_prefetch_window to 1 for now or disable prefetch for rerank workloads until we have a correctness test.

ani: we should add a unit/integration test for kvcache isolation in the eval harness: simulate two different queries batched together and assert no token-prefix bleed.

morgan: agreed. I'll open an issue and push a provisional patch to disable prefetch by default for rerank tests.

raj: thanks — can you link the CL in the issue? also add a short note in the dashboard that this NDCG regression correlates with runner change so product dashboards show degradation reason.

morgan: filed: https://redwood.internal/issue/ENGML-2147 — includes repro, logs, and a minimal failing unit test. patch: https://redwood.internal/cl/CL-7777

infra-bot: rollback scheduled: revert CL-7712 (prefetch+affinity) to canary in 5m if no objections.

lee: no objections. canary rollback looks good.

morgan: ran quick smoke after applying kv.prefetch.isolate_per_request=true locally — NDCG back within noise (~0.1%). pushing patch and test shortly.

sam: nice debug, thanks. once CI passes we should add a todo to benchmark prefetch in a controlled setup (different batch sizes / affinity modes).

ani: adding eval harness test to my queue, will PR tonight.

raj: assign ENGML-2147 to morgan and set priority=high. :thumbsup:

morgan: thanks all, will follow up with postmortem note and dashboard annotation.
